title: SAML cert rotation
resolution_summary: Rotated IdP certificate in Okta and updated CloudDesk SSO config. Verified with test user before full rollout.
troubleshooting_steps: Identified expired SAML signing certificate in Okta
Generated new certificate in Okta
Updated CloudDesk Admin → Security → SSO Configuration with new cert
Tested with single user account
Rolled out to all 200 users

title: Refund for 5 deactivated seats
resolution_summary: Issued prorated refund for 5 seats deactivated before billing period start. Refund approved by billing admin.
troubleshooting_steps: Verified seat deactivation dates in billing history
Confirmed deactivation was before period start (Dec 1)
Calculated prorated amount: 5 seats × $15 × 30/30 = $75
Submitted refund request for approval
Approved by billing admin, processed to original payment method

args.reason: Prorated refund for 5 seats deactivated before period start

title: API 429 on batch job
resolution_summary: Identified burst limit issue. Recommended exponential backoff and request spreading. Customer implemented fixes.
troubleshooting_steps: Analyzed API logs — burst of 150 requests in 30 seconds
Business plan burst limit is 100/minute
Recommended exponential backoff with jitter
Suggested spreading job over 5-minute window
Customer implemented changes, no further 429s

title: Storage quota exceeded - version cleanup
resolution_summary: Workspace at 98% capacity. Enabled auto-cleanup keeping last 10 versions. Freed 45 GB.
troubleshooting_steps: Checked storage breakdown: 60% file versions, 25% trash, 15% active files
Enabled Admin → Workspace → Version Retention: keep last 10, delete older than 90 days
Ran manual cleanup job
Emptied trash folder
Usage dropped from 98% to 55%

title: External sharing blocked on Pro plan
resolution_summary: Pro plan supports read-only external sharing. Admin had disabled it in workspace settings. Re-enabled and tested.
troubleshooting_steps: Verified Pro plan includes external sharing (read-only)
Checked Workspace Admin → Settings → Security → External Sharing
Found setting was disabled by previous admin
Re-enabled external sharing
Tested with contractor email — share link created successfully

title: Slack integration webhook failure
resolution_summary: Slack bot token was revoked during workspace migration. Reinstalled Slack app, reconfigured channel.
troubleshooting_steps: Checked Integration Settings → Slack → Connection Status: 'Disconnected'
Found 'app_uninstalled' in Slack audit log from 3 days ago
Reinstalled Slack app via Settings → Integrations → Slack
Re-added bot to #support channel: /invite @CloudDesk
Test connection successful, notifications resumed

title: MFA lockout - backup codes used
resolution_summary: User lost authenticator app. Used backup code to regain access, then set up new MFA with WebAuthn.
troubleshooting_steps: User attempted login, clicked 'Use backup code'
Entered one of 10 saved backup codes (8-digit)
Successfully logged in
Immediately went to Settings → Security → MFA
Registered WebAuthn security key (YubiKey) as primary
Regenerated backup codes and saved in password manager

title: GDPR workspace deletion request
resolution_summary: Processed GDPR erasure request for Legacy-Archive workspace. 30-day grace period initiated, data export provided.
troubleshooting_steps: Verified request from registered admin email
Confirmed workspace unused for 2+ years
Initiated deletion: Workspace → Settings → Delete Workspace
Generated data export (JSON + files ZIP) for customer
Sent completion certificate with erasure categories
Workspace in 'pending deletion' state, recoverable for 30 days

title: File recovery from .sync-conflicts
resolution_summary: 200+ files 'disappeared' — found in .sync-conflicts folder from GitHub integration. Restored to original location.
troubleshooting_steps: Searched audit log for delete events — none found
Checked Workspace → .sync-conflicts folder
Found 234 files from 'Q4 Financials' folder
Files moved by GitHub sync during merge conflict
Selected all → Restore to original location
Verified all files accessible and intact

title: Payment dispute - fraudulent charge
resolution_summary: Investigated $2,400 charge. Found unauthorized plan upgrade via compromised admin credentials. Reversed charge, enforced MFA.
troubleshooting_steps: Reviewed audit log: admin@midmarket.demo upgraded plan at 03:00 UTC
IP geolocation: different country from admin's usual location
Admin confirmed credentials compromised (phishing)
Reverted plan to Business, issued full refund
Enforced MFA on all admin accounts
Rotated all API keys

args.reason: Compromised admin credentials, unauthorized plan change
